'''Tur''' was a [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrip]] guard loyal to the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] [[Noira]]. Tur was raised at birth to serve the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. Tur wore custom-made [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielded a large, spiked [[Mace (weapon)/Legends|mace]].<ref name="Mask" />
